unit_rules.name: Yaaaargh Energy
unit_rules.text: While this model is a +Leader+, add 1 to the =hand-fist= Strength and =droplet= Damage traits of this model's Psychocollar for every 5 models in the unit (rounding down). While this model's unit has 10 or more models, the Psychocollar gains +[Hazardous]+

unit_rules.name: Da Jump
unit_rules.text: After this model's unit finishes its Movement, you may use this ability. Roll d6; on a 1, this unit suffers d6 Mortal Damage. On a 2+, remove this model's unit from the Battlefield and replace it anywhere that is at least 9" horizontally from all enemy models.
